title: Director Quality and Accreditation
text:
**Location:**

Avera Heart Hospital

**Worker Type:**

Regular

**Work Shift:**

Day Shift (United States of America)

At Avera Heart Hospital, you’re not just joining a workplace – you’re becoming part of a family. With more than 700 dedicated employee, we deliver care that truly makes a difference. Our commitment to excellence has earned us the distinction of being one of only a handful of hospitals nationwide – out of more than 4,000 – to achieve a double 5-star rating from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

**Position Highlights:**

The Director of Quality Accreditation is accountable for the overall operations of Quality and Performance Improvement and Accreditation.

**Work Schedule:**

Monday through Friday

**Education/Experience:**

Bachelor’s in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Management or related field with a strong analytical base required.

Minimum of three years' experience in hospital facility, program management, and leading project teams required.

Master’s Degree preferred

Quality/Safety leadership experience preferred

**Online Privacy Policy**

At Avera, we are committed to protecting your online privacy. For more information, please visit https://www.avera.org/legal-notices/online-privacy-policy/
